about: Golden vectors of OCD's resolution order (rule round 45, item 3): a synthetic SIM in, the stack generic to specific, the serving profile, the step of the order that made it serve (reason) and the Google fill it picks out. tools/resolve_carrier_profiles.py --order android, tools/ocd_dataset.py, OcdCarrierSettings and the OCD Check app pass every vector. All SIM values are synthetic, built from published selectors.

source.tree: LineageOS 24.0 (the S20 ROM tree; TelephonyProvider at 8c7e341e0c8ff2630c56341e43f780608946b889)

sets.name: spec
sets.about: The 27 matcher vectors of the S20 spec (appendix A, 2026-10-25) with their own profiles and Google rules; the resolution order keeps every result.

sets.name: dataset
sets.about: OCD main 500525ec02f0dddf2351ab7233fcf05b930e34d0: every profile a vector's stack holds (and every profile of the owner's networks), with its match and fill list as profiles.json has them.

Carrier ID 999999 has no rule on 999-03: it counts at 256 with the carrier-ID step (logged on the phone), below the SPN profiles (258); the OCD SPN profile ranks above the fill-only one.
Equal weight, prefix and counts: the OCD profile above the fill-only one (step 3), whatever the IDs.
